title: 第23章 断剑第24章 太初剑诀
lines: 战刀之上竟然出现银白色雷电。
“雷罚之刃！”
雷罚之刃，乃是萧庚最强杀手锏，他本不愿这么早的暴露，但为了击败许辰，管不了那么多了。
看到萧庚施展雷罚之刃，许辰从中嗅到了一丝危险，毫不犹豫地抽身暴退。
“哈哈，许辰，我看你拿什么挡我的雷罚之刃！”
萧庚见到许辰后退，以为后者畏惧，不敢硬接，得意大笑道。
雷霆暴涌，战刀闪电般的落下。
许辰的速度终是慢了一步，被雷霆笼罩。
巨声响彻。
砖石堆砌的擂台裂开蜘蛛网般的裂痕。
烟尘骤起。
整个擂台都笼罩在烟尘之中。
“怎么样了？”
“许辰是死是活？”
“萧师兄这一刀威力太强了，连擂台都被摧毁得不成样，那许辰恐怕凶多吉少吧。”
“可惜了。”
“是啊，说起来，那许辰也是个天才，只是太不知天高地厚了，竟敢登台与萧师兄一战，现在死了也怨不得谁。”
众人看着那被烟尘笼罩的擂台，纷纷交头接耳，议论起来。
就在所有人以为许辰凶多吉少的时候，一道人影忽然从烟尘中冲出，直扑萧庚而去。
萧庚瞳孔一缩。
他看清了那飞扑而来的人影。
竟是许辰。
而且毫发无伤。
“怎么可能？”
他在心中惊呼出声。
无法接受眼前一幕。
许辰飞扑到萧庚面前，蓄势已久的一拳，借着冲势，闪电般的轰出。
萧庚仓促横刀挡在胸前。
萧庚被震得手臂发麻，身形不受控制地连连后退。
许辰上前，又是一拳轰出。
萧庚拼命抵挡。
“铛铛铛！
许辰挥动双拳，一拳接着一拳，不断轰在刀身之上。
萧庚一开始还能勉强抵挡，但到了后面，双臂已经被震得失去了知觉，终于随着又一声巨响，战刀脱手而飞。
许辰右腿之上灵力暴涌，咻的一声，一个鞭腿狠狠抽甩在萧庚腰部。
随着一声闷响，萧庚腰部炸开一团血雾，而他惨叫一声，身形不受控制的倒飞了出去。
content_en:
"Chi~"
Silver-white thunder and lightning appeared on the sword.
"Thunder Punishment Blade!"
The Thunder Punishment Blade was Xiao Geng's strongest weapon. He didn't want to be exposed so early, but in order to defeat Xu Chen, he couldn't care less.
Seeing Xiao Geng using the Thunder Punishment Blade, Xu Chen smelled a hint of danger and retreated without hesitation.
"Haha, Xu Chen, let me see what you can do to block my Thunder Punishment Blade!"
When Xiao Geng saw Xu Chen retreating, he thought that the latter was afraid and did not dare to fight hard, so he laughed proudly.
Thunder surged, and the sword fell like lightning.
Xu Chen's speed finally slowed down a step and was enveloped by thunder.
"Bang!"
Loud noises resounded.
The brick-and-stone arena cracked like spider webs of cracks.
Smoke and dust suddenly rose.
The entire arena was shrouded in smoke and dust.
"How's it going?"
"Is Xu Chen dead or alive?"
"Senior Brother Xiao's sword was so powerful that even the arena was destroyed, so Xu Chen is probably more likely to be in danger than anything else."
"What a pity."
"Yes, speaking of it, Xu Chen is also a genius, but he is so ignorant that he dared to go on stage to fight against Senior Brother Xiao. Now that he dies, he has no one to blame."
Everyone looked at the arena shrouded in smoke and dust, and began to whisper and discuss.
"Phew!"
Just when everyone thought Xu Chen was in danger, a figure suddenly rushed out of the smoke and rushed towards Xiao Geng.
Xiao Geng's pupils shrank.
He saw clearly the figure flying towards him.
It was Xu Chen.
And unscathed.
"How is that possible?"
He exclaimed in his mind.
Unable to accept the scene before me.
Xu Chenfei rushed in front of Xiao Geng, and a punch that he had prepared for a long time flew out like lightning with the momentum.
Xiao Geng hurriedly held the knife in front of his chest.
"Cang!"
Xiao Geng was so shocked that his arms went numb and he retreated uncontrollably.
"Cang!"
Xu Chen stepped forward and punched out again.
Xiao Geng resisted with all his strength.
“Clang clang clang!
! "
Xu Chen waved his fists, punching one after another, constantly hitting the blade.
Xiao Geng could barely resist at first, but later, his arms were shocked and he lost consciousness. Finally, with another loud noise, the sword flew away from his hand.
The spiritual energy on Xu Chen's right leg surged, and with a hiss, a whip leg was slapped hard on Xiao Geng's waist.
"Bang!"
With a muffled sound, a cloud of blood mist exploded from Xiao Geng's waist, and he screamed and flew backwards uncontrollably.
